+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer, SecurityScopes
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import pytest
+
+app = FastAPI()
+oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")
+
+def dep_c(security_scopes: SecurityScopes):
+    return security_scopes.scopes
+
+def dep_b(security_scopes: SecurityScopes, c=Security(dep_c, scopes=["b_scope"])):
+    return {"b_scopes": security_scopes.scopes, "c_scopes": c}
+
+@app.get("/")
+async def root(b=Security(dep_b, scopes=["root_scope"])):
+    return b
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_hierarchical_scopes():
+    response = client.get("/", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer token"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    print(f"Data: {data}")
+    
+    # dep_b should have ["root_scope"]
+    assert data["b_scopes"] == ["root_scope"]
+    # dep_c should have ["root_scope", "b_scope"]
+    assert data["c_scopes"] == ["root_scope", "b_scope"]
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_hierarchical_scopes()
+    print("Test passed!")
